method: Primary evidence-type annotations derived from saved automated v3 adjudication explanations and decisive evidence; original source states were not independently reviewed. Each representation/criterion loss is counted once. When multiple items are missing, the rationale identifies the primary gap; secondary gaps remain in the linked audit. URL identity gaps include blocker-to-page and response-to-endpoint associations. Only confirmed source-loss findings are exported.

definitions.Exact text and values: Missing scalar text, exact dates, numeric values, symbols, or displayed notation.
definitions.URLs: Missing exact URL, endpoint, domain, or URL-based source-identity association.
definitions.Control states: Missing checked, selected, enabled, or other explicit control states.
definitions.Table entries: Missing structured rows or row-level associations needed for extraction.
definitions.Label–value links: A preserved label, heading, or value is disconnected from its required counterpart.
definitions.Capture omissions: An entire record, list boundary, content region, or substantial field description falls outside the retained capture.
